data.title: 春原瞬 · 晨光梳妆镜前的旗袍回眸
data.description: 清晨的柔光穿透木格花窗，洒在古色古香的梳妆台前。瞬身穿深紫底金纹的华丽旗袍，修长的旗袍侧开衩展露出无可挑剔的光洁长腿。她正手持檀木梳梳理着如瀑青丝，从黄铜镜中望见走来的老师，嘴角绽开极尽宠溺的温婉笑意，虎耳快意地微晃，宛如一幅典雅绝艳的仕女图卷。
data.action: seated at antique vanity mirror holding sandalwood comb, elegant purple qipao with high leg slit, looking back with fond pampering smile in mirror reflection
data.location: traditional Chinese vanity table with carved lattice window
data.lighting: pure morning sunbeams illuminating dust motes and lustrous dark hair
data.mood: classical oriental elegance, enchanting wife-like serenity
data.promptProse: Seated at a wooden vanity table combing her glossy black hair, Sunohara Shun turns gracefully in a purple patterned cheongsam. Golden morning light floods through lattice windows as she offers a doting, beautiful smile.
data.animaCaption: Shun combing her long black hair at a vanity table in an elegant qipao, smiling warmly.
